title: Dynamics: soft in the middle, loud on the last chorus
summary: He explains how bands played loud, dropped soft mid-tune and went out heavy, and that nobody played clarinet in the low register before him.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels
